verdict.rationale: Expensify's Integration Server API documents programmatic download of expense report data, which is a first-party path to get data out. Nothing shows a complete account export or what formats are used. The QuickBooks and NetSuite syncs move data into other proprietary accounting systems and are not open-format exports. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export covering all data types, explicit open formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), an account-closure or offboarding data-portability process, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
